title: Flood takes out causeway, arches complete, structures to hold deck prepared
description: Spanning 1,144 feet from bank to bank, the Hartland Bridge features a 26-foot roadway supported by seven spandrel-type reinforced concrete arches. It was the first bridge in the Atlantic provinces to use this spandrel construction system. Concrete pillars of varying lengths support the deck, which carries the roadway and 24-inch sidewalks on each side.
